description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early engineering team building AI-powered software that helps small businesses manage operations and grow. You will take customer problems from discovery through production, working across the stack to build dependable tools and AI-driven workflows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Scope and ship complete features, from backend services and data models to user interfaces, then learn from how customers use them.

 - Build integrations with business systems such as CRMs, accounting tools, email, phone, and SMS, including systems with non-standard APIs.

 - Develop data models and pipelines that organize business records into useful context for AI agents.

 - Build agent capabilities including retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and human approval workflows.

 - Debug issues across third-party APIs, application data, and model outputs, and address their root causes.

 - Contribute to code review, AI-assisted development workflows, and engineering practices for a fast-moving team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 8 years of full-stack engineering experience shipping products across backend, frontend, and data layers.

 - A track record of taking products from zero to real users, ideally in a startup or as an early engineer.

 - Experience building product features with LLMs, including prompting, retrieval, tool use, and evaluations.

 - Experience integrating third-party systems or building data pipelines with messy or non-standard APIs.

 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, systems design, and debugging, with the ability to solve problems across multiple layers.

 - Experience using AI-first development tools in day-to-day work; production experience with agent reliability, evaluation tools, or guardrails is a plus.

 - Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows or mobile and mobile-web experiences is also useful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

Hybrid in San Francisco, California.
